verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भीमसेनोऽपि वीर्यवान्। धर्मराजमनुज्ञाप्य ययौ प्राचीं दिशं प्रति॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said In the meantime, having received the permission of Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), the powerful Bhimasena marched towards the east.

verses.sanskrit: महता बलचक्रेण परराष्ट्रावमर्दिना। हस्त्यश्वरथपूर्णेन दंशितेन प्रतापवान्॥२॥
verses.english: That best of the Bharata race (Bhima), that hero of great velour and enhancer of the enemy's sorrow, was accompanied by a powerful army with the full compliment of elephants, horses and cars, an army well-armed and capable of grinding all hostile kingdoms, that best of men (Bhima) first went to thereat country of the Panchalas.

verses.sanskrit: वृतो भरतशार्दूलो द्विषच्छोकविवर्धनः। स गत्वा नरशार्दूलः पञ्चालानां पुरं महत्॥३॥
पञ्चालान्विविधोपायैः सान्त्वयामास पाण्डवः। ततः स गण्डकाञ्छूरो विदेहान्भरतर्षभः॥४॥
verses.english: The Pandava (Bhima) began to conciliate the Panchalas by various means. Then that best of the Bharata race soon defeated the Gandakas and Videhas. The Lord (Bhima) then subjugated the Dasarnas. The king of the Dasarnas, Sudharma.

verses.sanskrit: विजित्याल्पेन कालेन दशार्णानजयत्प्रभुः। तत्र दाशार्णको राजा सुधर्मा रोमहर्षणम्। कृतवान्भीमसेनेन महद्युद्धं निरायुधम्॥५॥
भीमसेनस्तु तद्दृष्ट्वा तस्य कर्म महात्मनः। अधिसेनापतिं चक्रे सुधर्माणं महाबलम्॥६॥
verses.english: Fought a fearful battle with Bhima without any arms. Seeing the feat of that illustrious (king), Bhimasena installed installed the mighty Sudharma as the generalissimo (of his army).

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राचीं दिशं भीमो ययौ भीमपराक्रमः। सैन्येन महता राजन्कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥७॥
verses.english: O king, causing the earth itself to tremble with the tread of the mighty army that followed him, then Bhima of fearful velour marched towards the east.
verses.bhavadeepa: अधिचक्रे इति संबन्धः । जित्वा तस्य बलं ज्ञात्वा सैनापत्यं  तस्मै दत्तवानित्यर्थः । अधिसेनापतिं सेनापतिष्वधिकं मुख्यं  चक्रे इति वाऽर्थः ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: सोऽश्वमेधेश्वरं राजन्रोचमानं सहानुगम्। जिगाय समरे वीरो बलेन बलिनां वरः॥८॥
verses.english: O king, that hero, the foremost of all mighty men, then defeated in battle Rochaman, the king of Ashvamedha, with all his troops.

verses.sanskrit: स तं निर्जित्य कौन्तेयो नातितीव्रेण कर्मणा। पूर्वदेशं महावीर्यो विजिग्ये कुरनन्दनः॥९॥
verses.english: Having vanquished that king by performing feats that excelled in fierceness, the greatly powerful descendant of Kuru subjugated the eastern region.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दक्षिणमागम्य पुलिन्दनगरं महत्। सुकुमारं वशे चक्रे सुमित्रं च नराधिपम्॥१०॥
verses.english: He then went to the south in the great city of the Pulindas and subjugated Sukumara and the king Sumitra.
O Janamejaya, then at the command of Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, that best of the Bharata race marched against the greatly powerful Shishupala.

verses.sanskrit: चेदिराजोऽपि तच्छ्रुत्वा पाण्डवस्य चिकीर्षितम्। उपनिष्क्रम्य नगरात्प्रत्यगृह्णात्परन्तप॥१२॥
verses.english: Having heard the intentions of the Pandava (Bhima), the king of Chedi came out of his city. That chastiser of foes then received the son of Pritha with all respects.

verses.sanskrit: तौ समेत्य महाराज कुरुचेदिवृषौ तदा। उभयोरात्मकुलयोः कौशल्यं पर्यपृच्छताम्॥१३॥
verses.english: O great king, those two best of the Kuru and the Chedi race then met together and inquired after each other's welfare.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवेद्य तद्राष्ट्रं चेदिराजो विशाम्पते। उवाच भीमं प्रहसन्किमिदं कुरुषेऽनघ॥१४॥
verses.english: O king, the king of Chedi offered his kingdom to Bhima, and he smilingly said "O sinless one, what are you bent upon to do?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भीमस्तदाचख्यौ धर्मराजचिकीर्षितम्। स च तं प्रतिगृह्यैव तथा चक्रे नराधिपः॥१५॥
verses.english: Thereupon Bhima told him all about the intentions of the king Yudhishthira. That king acted as desired (by the Pandava).

verses.sanskrit: ततो भीमस्तत्र राजन्नुषित्वा त्रिदशाः क्षपाः। सत्कृतः शिशुपालेन ययौ सबलवाहनः॥१६॥
verses.english: O king, having been duly entertained by Shishupala, Bhima lived there for thirty nights. He then set out from Chedi with his troops and vehicles.
